$comment: RAG PQ gold set: 20 items, 18 positive and 2 negative controls, still BELOW the 30-50 the PQ needs, and not PQ-ready. 0.3.0-seed (2026-09-28; authority docs/evidence/D4/2026-09-28-pq-rag-unblock-misdescribed/, E4 and 'What rag needs' item 4; proof at docs/evidence/D4/2026-09-28-pq-rag-fail-closed/data/) changed no item's meaning. It added three things. (1) expectedSourceKeys on every item: document_code@version keys into guidance-corpus-manifest.json, [] on the two negative controls. (2) keysProvisional: true while any keyed manifest entry has an unverified version; verification may re-pin a version and then rewrites the key here in the same commit. (3) openChecks on items whose expected substrings may not appear in the keyed official text; each is resolved from the verified text before the item is scored. expectedSourceIds stays [] on purpose. run-eval compares each retrieved documentId, so expected ids must be DOCUMENT ids (not chunk or atom ids, as this comment said before 0.3.0) of the evaluation organisation's Vault corpus, and those ids differ per database. The resolver from keys to ids belongs to server/eval/rag/run-eval.ts and does not exist yet. It resolves through the vault upsert key (programme, document_code, version), checks content_hash against the manifest sha256 and refuses unverified entries. Until it lands, hit-rate still scores 0 items. Every manifest entry is verified:false (no issuer site was reachable on 2026-09-28), so no key may resolve until its entry is verified. No items were added: a new positive item requires an 'evidence' field ({document_code, section, quote}) quoting the verified official text that answers it, and no official text could be fetched. expectedAnswerContains on new items must be substrings of that quote.
